neighbours.label: groundwater below the surface: aquifer, water table, groundwater
fire: Farmers in the valley pump irrigation water from a deep aquifer.
Heavy pumping has lowered the water table by several meters.
Nitrate from fertilizer can leach into groundwater over time.
The town's wells draw from a sandstone aquifer beneath the plain.
During the drought, the water table dropped below the old well.
Contaminants spread slowly through the aquifer toward the river.
Rainfall recharges the groundwater beneath the hills each spring.
Engineers mapped the shallow aquifer before building the landfill.
quiet: Farmers in the valley pump irrigation water from a nearby river.
Heavy rain has raised the level of the lake by several meters.
Nitrate from fertilizer can wash into streams over time.
The town's taps draw from a reservoir behind the dam on the plain.
During the drought, the creek dried up below the old mill.
Contaminants spread slowly through the wetland toward the sea.
Rainfall fills the ponds beneath the hills each spring.
Engineers mapped the floodplain before building the landfill.

notes: Card: ' groundwater' x8, ' aqu' x7, ' table' after 'water' x2 in the top 32. Near misses keep hydrology but use surface water (rivers, lakes, reservoirs). The + pole is unrelated (aphid, mealybug, lichen).
